package.name: mower_interfaces
package.description: Core message and service definitions for the Airseekers Tron ROS 2 port. Faithful ROS 1 (mower_msgs) to ROS 2 conversion of the core subset: motor info, sensor info, control state, base status, and planner task set. Battery state and wheel velocity reuse the standard sensor_msgs/BatteryState and geometry_msgs/TwistStamped types already used on the live mower.
